LO0463 Transmission Behaviour Report

KOTH · L621DAMA0A0614 · last 7 days from Sandvik FDM Event Hub  ·  Status: Transmission Concern

Headline findings

  • 🔴 LO0463 transmission oil reached 138.2°C (51% of operating time > 100°C threshold); L621DVSA0A0995 stayed below 89.2°C (max < 90°C).
  • 🔴 LO0463 logged 197 improper declutch events (declutch while moving forward or on grade); the comparison loader logged 0.
  • 🟡 Direct gear-skip direction changes (F→R without Neutral): LO0463 55.0/hr (720 in 13.1h moving) vs comparison 26.8/hr (134 in 5.0h moving).
  • 🔴 Mean torque-converter slip with lockup engaged: LO0463 12.5% vs comparison 4.8% — LO0463 lockup clutch showing wear.
  • 🟡 Downhill time without converter lockup: LO0463 48% (2295s of 4770s) vs comparison 50% (1085s of 2150s) — both machines rely on torque-converter slip / engine braking for downhill retardation.

Recommendations

🟡 Retrain operator on direction-change protocol
LO0463 recorded 246 no-stop direction changes in 13.1 h of moving time (18.8/hr). Direct gear-skip transitions (F→R or R→F with no Neutral) = 720. Coach operator: bring machine to a complete stop (Neutral + brake) before reversing direction.
Watch
🔴 Stop using declutch while moving forward / on grade
197 improper declutch events (declutch engaged while moving forward and/or on grade). Comparison loader: 0. Operator should only declutch at standstill (or use inching pedal at very low speed).
Action
🔴 Inspect torque-converter lockup clutch
Mean torque-converter slip with lockup engaged: 12.5% vs comparison 4.8%. Healthy lockup should be ~0–3%. Inspect lockup clutch friction material; check transmission oil for debris.
Action
🟡 Engage lockup on downhill loaded travel
51% of operating time above 100°C on LO0463 vs 0% on comparison. Max 138.2°C (LO0463) vs 89.2°C (L621DVSA0A0995). On loaded downhill travel, engage lockup or use engine brake to keep converter from generating heat. Verify oil cooler airflow and fan operation.
Watch
🟢 Baseline behaviour is achievable on the same machine class
Tropicana L621DVSA0A0995 (1,966.0 tx-hrs) shows transmission oil stays below 90°C, slip-with-lockup below 5%, and zero improper declutch events. Same machine class (LH621i) confirms the operating envelope is achievable.
Good
